title_en: Case of Judicial Detention of the Head of Mishan City Leather Shoe Factory for Obstructing Civil Proceedings
keywords_en: civil; dispute over a sales contract; first instance; basic people's court; Jilin Province; Heilongjiang Province; legal person; Civil Procedure Law; acts obstructing civil proceedings; application of judicial detention; upholding the plaintiff's claim; arrears for goods; tearing off seals; transferring seized property
full_text_en:
Jilin Yanbian Leather Factory v. Heilongjiang Mishan Leather Shoe Factory — dispute over contract debt and judicial detention for obstruction of civil proceedings

Plaintiff: Jilin Yanbian Leather Factory
Legal Representative: Wang Xiliang, Factory Director
Agent ad litem: Liu Min, Manager of Yanbian Leather Factory Distribution Company

Defendant: Heilongjiang Mishan Leather Shoe Factory
Legal Representative: Chi Dewen, Factory Director
Agent ad litem: Guo Xingkui, Deputy Factory Director of Mishan Leather Shoe Factory

From 1990 to April 1991, the plaintiff, Jilin Yanbian Leather Factory, and the defendant, Heilongjiang Mishan Leather Shoe Factory, had multiple business transactions for the purchase and sale of leather goods. The plaintiff supplied leather products to the defendant. After settlement, the defendant still owed the plaintiff RMB 152,573.89 in payment for goods. On May 20, 1991, the defendant again came to the plaintiff to sign a leather purchase and sale contract for goods worth RMB 116,377.88. Both parties agreed that this payment together with the previously owed payment totaled RMB 268,951.77, to be paid in full before the end of 1991. Subsequently, the defendant took delivery of the goods on its own. On November 4, 1991, the plaintiff went to the defendant to demand payment. The defendant wrote a repayment agreement, stating that it would pay RMB 100,000 in December of the same year, another RMB 100,000 in January 1992, and the full amount by the end of February; if not paid by the end of February, interest would be paid at the bank loan interest rate. After the agreement expired, the plaintiff sent personnel to the defendant six times to demand payment. The defendant only paid the plaintiff RMB 907.70 and refused to pay the remaining amount on the ground of lack of funds. Seeing no hope of recovering the payment, the plaintiff filed a lawsuit with the Longjing People's Court of Jilin Province on February 21, 1993, requesting that the defendant pay the overdue payment, interest, and travel expenses incurred in demanding payment, totaling RMB 296,656.33.

After accepting the case, the Longjing People's Court sent personnel to the defendant's location the next day to first conduct mediation. Due to significant differences of opinion between the parties, mediation failed. When the court served the complaint on the defendant, the defendant indicated that it would not submit a written defense. Subsequently, the Longjing People's Court issued a summons for the defendant to appear in court, but the defendant failed to appear without justifiable reasons. After trial, the Longjing People's Court held that the purchase and sale contract signed by the plaintiff and the defendant was valid and both parties should perform it voluntarily. The defendant's refusal to pay was unjustified and it should bear full liability for breach of contract. The court, in accordance with Article 130 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, rendered a default judgment: the defendant shall, immediately after the judgment takes effect, make a lump-sum payment to the plaintiff for the overdue payment, accrued interest, and travel expenses totaling RMB 296,656.33. The case acceptance fee of RMB 6,969.85 shall be borne by the defendant. On March 23, the court served the judgment on the defendant. The defendant refused to sign for receipt.

After the judgment, the plaintiff applied to the court for preservation of one Mitsubishi truck and the leather jackets in the defendant's finished product warehouse and sample warehouse, and provided security in accordance with the law. The Longjing People's Court, after reviewing the plaintiff's preservation application, found that the application complied with Articles 92 and 94 of the Civil Procedure Law, and issued a ruling to seal up the defendant's finished product warehouse and sample warehouse, and to seize one Japanese-made Mitsubishi truck. After the judgment and ruling were served by substituted service, a director from the Mishan Second Light Industry Bureau arrived and instructed ten workers to guard the gate to prevent the seized truck from being driven out. To avoid escalation of the conflict, the judicial personnel requested the director of the Second Light Industry Bureau to provide a guarantee. After the request was refused, the judicial personnel had no choice but to seal up the truck on site. After the judgment was served, the defendant did not appeal within the statutory time limit, and the judgment became legally effective.

After entering the enforcement stage, the president of the Longjing People's Court led enforcement personnel to Mishan City on April 23 to execute the judgment. Upon arriving at the scene, the enforcement personnel found that the defendant had unilaterally torn off the seals on the sealed warehouse and moved the seized vehicle. In response to such serious obstruction of civil proceedings, the court, in accordance with Article 102, paragraph 1, items (3) and (6), paragraph 2, and Article 105 of the Civil Procedure Law, and with the approval of the court president, decided to detain Chi Dewen, factory director of Mishan Leather Shoe Factory, and Shi Jianbo, deputy factory director, for fifteen days each, and handed them over to the local public security authorities for custody. Under the deterrence of the law, Chi Dewen and Shi Jianbo admitted their mistakes, expressed willingness to comply with the court's judgment, and provided the enforcement personnel with the address where the vehicle was hidden.

After overcoming the interference, the Longjing People's Court made a decision on April 24 to lift the judicial detention of Chi Dewen and Shi Jianbo early. Subsequently, the plaintiff and the defendant reached an enforcement agreement: the defendant would pay RMB 70,000 in cash to the plaintiff, and the remaining debt would be fully satisfied by using property in lieu of cash.
